intro.title: Founded to close a gap.
intro.body: Da Mario's Fashion and Technology Institute was founded in 2024 by Dr. Senait Mario. It exists to bridge the gap between education and employment.
intro.vision: To become a world-class international institute providing purpose-driven higher education and high-impact research that transforms lives and contributes to social and economic development.

founder.title: Dr. Senait Mario
founder.subtitle: Sociologist. Designer. Model. Founder.
founder.intro: Born and raised in Wolaita Sodo in southern Ethiopia, Dr. Senait Mario trained as a sociologist before turning to fashion. Today she is an Italian citizen — Ethiopian by birth — and the founder and CEO of Da Mario's Fashion and Technology Institute. Her stated approach: she promotes Ethiopia through the colours she uses in her collections.

wolaita-sodo.body: Born and raised in Wolaita Sodo, southern Ethiopia. A sociologist by training.

nairobi-kampala.body: She left Ethiopia around 2009, living first in Kenya and then in Uganda.

rome.body: She settled in Rome and became an Italian citizen — Ethiopian by birth — turning from sociology to fashion design and modelling.

runways.body: Her work has been presented on the fashion stages of Milan, London and Paris — collections that promote Ethiopia through their colours.

addis.body: Back to Addis to build an institute: in 2024 she founded Da Mario's Fashion and Technology Institute, with a stated mission to promote Ethiopia in the fashion industry while attracting investment to Ethiopia to support youth empowerment.

recognition.top40: Recognised among the Top 40 Women of Africa at the MICE award, Ghana.
recognition.doctorate: Awarded an honorary doctorate in Nigeria for work promoting African culture.

founder.showsBody: She organises the African Fashion Expo and the Fashion for Peace / One Peace Fashion Show. In 2019 she staged a Peace Fashion Show in her hometown of Wolaita Sodo, alongside the Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples' regional cultural festival — featuring the work of eight Ethiopian designers and attended by the State Minister of Tourism and Culture, the Vice President of the Southern regional state, and the head of the Addis Ababa Women, Children and Youth Affairs Bureau, together with embassy and international-organisation guests.

partnerships.title: Partnerships
partnerships.lead: The institute's partnerships connect Addis Ababa to Rome, where its founder built her career.

rbs.framing: The partnership is framed around international academic and cultural exchange: exposure for Ethiopian instructors to global peers, and study-abroad opportunities for students.
